name: The Hive
description: End-game hidden threat. Every independent colony at game start is a node of one hidden mind. A node absorbed by an empire stays a node; at a threshold of absorption The Chorus declares, taking every still-independent node outright and rising from inside every absorbed one.

flags.name: hive
flags.label: The Hive
flags.description: Independent colonies are secretly one mind that rises when enough are absorbed.

params.name: hiveThresholdPct
params.label: Percent of nodes absorbed that triggers the Hive

params.name: hiveMinNodes
params.label: Minimum independent colonies for the Hive to seed

params.name: hiveMaxNodesSeized
params.label: Still-independent nodes seized outright at the trigger (cap; nearest the largest absorbed cluster first)

params.name: hiveExistChancePct
params.label: Chance the Hive exists in this game (%; -1 = use the shared value)

params.name: hiveMinYear
params.label: Earliest year the Hive may seed, trigger or rise (-1 = use the shared value)
